description: Source code for the SpikerComponent class, which manages spike firing behavior, damage handling, and targeting logic in a game. It includes methods for calculating damage, avoiding friendly fire, and distributing missile launches across multiple rows.

classes.name: SpikerComponent
classes.description: A component class responsible for managing spike firing, damage response, and targeting logic for a game entity.

methods.name: HandleDamage
methods.description: Handles damage events; triggers firing if expected damage indicates a viable target.

methods.name: SetGravityCompensation
methods.description: Calculates gravity compensation based on entity orientation to adjust spike damage radius.

methods.name: Think
methods.description: Main logic loop for assessing targets, calculating expected damage, and deciding when to fire spikes.

methods.name: SafeToShoot
methods.description: Checks if firing in a given direction would hit friendly entities, avoiding friendly fire.

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Executes the spike firing sequence, distributing missiles across multiple rows with randomization.

methods.name: RegisterFastThinker
methods.description: Registers the component for frequent updates.

methods.name: RegisterSlowThinker
methods.description: Registers the component for less frequent updates.
